stage: After full reading, byte verification and preliminary PAPER derivation; before new executable mathematical controls
chosen_mechanism: Retain all powers of each actual prime in one centered Hilbert-Schmidt channel, and return the entire continuous channel before bounding the two-copy functional

predictions.P1: The four centered sectors reassemble as V_A + 2 Tr(A_centered H_decay_centered) + V_H; no mixed sector vanishes for free.
predictions.P2: The complete continuous return changes U2 by its actual mean plus a quantity of modulus at most sqrt((d-1)/d)*sqrt(V_H), with V_H <= 2(log m-1+1/m).
predictions.P3: Full same-prime channels include every pair of powers, and their summed squared size is at most 48*d*log(m)*(6+3*log(m)). This does not estimate the distinct-prime sum or the mean.
predictions.P4: Tensor Mobius-log coefficients at distinct primes remain log(p)*log(q); the two cutoffs cannot be replaced by a single product cutoff.
predictions.P5: At s=t=L/2 the genuine sparse-P two-copy kernel need not vanish even though the causal forward product has shift L. Its coefficient is small on the stated prime-square subsequence; no full variance lower is inferred.
predictions.P6: An independent favorable joint bound for the actual mean and distinct-prime contribution is not presumed, and no numerical or toy test will be promoted to an actual spectral obstruction.
